revisions.title: Touchscreen finger test - harness, diagnostics and owner instructions
intended_changes: tools/s10plus/a33/nuxel-touch-capture.sh: now drives the tracer's --capture mode (per-event JSONL + coordinate-map.json guaranteed), prints the exact tap sequence to perform (tap, three corner taps, swipe, multi-contact, open Settings/return Home/open Terminal/scroll/select an app, on-screen keyboard), reports the JSONL/coordinate-map evidence paths and the host-side --archive command, and is shellcheck-clean (the SC2010 `ls | grep` count replaced by find)

docs/beta-finalization/manual-proof/01-touchscreen.md: a new section 0 with the live measured state (charger/LPM boot - the test cannot pass right now), the numbered action sequence incl. the mission's completion definition, the JSONL/coordinate-map expected results, the new machine-runnable modes, a log-evidence-vs-human-proof table, and refreshed automatic evidence
docs/beta-finalization/touch/PIPELINE-TRACE.md: the harness/tool modes and the completion definition cross-referenced

evidence.result: 33/33 PASS - --commands arms nothing, CAPTURE_GATE=PASS can only come from gate.json pass:true, an empty capture is FAIL + NEEDS_OWNER_TEST, the bundle is never written inside the repository
bounded, terminates in ~2 s, prints the sequence, CAPTURE_GATE=FAIL, VERDICT=NEEDS_OWNER_TEST, and the events.jsonl / coordinate-map.json evidence paths
the manual-proof fragment carries the sequence, the completion definition, the log paths, PASS/FAIL criteria and the log-evidence-vs-human-proof split

tests: L2/L3: test-capture-harness.py 33/33 (no arming without a finger, machine gate from gate.json only, no repo litter, unwritable --out is a hard block)
dry-run on the host: bounded, prints the sequence and the evidence paths, never PASS without evidence
L6: the finger test itself remains NEEDS_OWNER_TEST and is never auto-promoted
revisions.owner_action: OWNER TEST REQUIRED: on a NORMAL boot (unplug the charger first; the device is currently in charger/LPM mode) run nuxel-touch-capture.sh --seconds 90 and perform the printed sequence; confirm on screen that Settings opens, Home returns, Terminal opens, the launcher scrolls, an app starts and the on-screen keyboard accepts typing. See docs/beta-finalization/manual-proof/01-touchscreen.md section 4
revisions.note: Resumed from the rev-1 seed (it was still pending). The harness now uses the tracer's --capture mode so the owner taps are recorded as per-event JSONL with kernel timestamps plus a validated coordinate map, and it prints the exact sequence including the mission's completion definition (open Settings, return Home, open Terminal, scroll the launcher, select an app, use the on-screen keyboard). The item terminates at NEEDS_OWNER_TEST: no finger has touched the glass in this cycle and nothing here is promoted to VERIFIED_ON_S10PLUS.
